title: HRW: Malian Military Drone Strikes and Insurgent Executions Documented Against Civilians and Captured Soldiers
detail: On October 19, 2026, Human Rights Watch published findings (30 remote interviews, July 30-Sept 20) documenting an apparent Malian military drone strike on a cattle market at Tombonkore, Bandiagara (Aug 19; 6 civilians killed, 20+ injured), a likely Shahed-type drone strike on a health center at Talahandak, Kidal (Jul 29), Dozo militia killings of Fulani men in Djenné (Jul 27-28), and the army's killing of five girls at Niono (Jul 12), which it later apologized for. HRW also reports that at least 19 surrendered soldiers were executed after the Jul 18 Tabrichat convoy attack by JNIM and FLA fighters; both groups deny ordering it. HRW cites ACLED figures for April-August 2026: 268 civilians killed by Malian forces and 134 by JNIM. Single-source (HRW, Tier 3); not independently confirmed here.
